title: Procedural Shader Playground with Live GLSL Editing
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements a procedural shader playground with live GLSL fragment shader editing. Requirements:

## Scene Setup
- Black background, orthographic camera looking at a full-screen quad (plane geometry spanning the viewport).
- The quad uses a ShaderMaterial with a custom vertex and fragment shader.
- The default fragment shader should render an animated procedural pattern: a combination of sine-wave color bands modulated by time. Specifically, the default fragment code should produce color channels: r = 0.5 + 0.5*sin(uv.x*10.0 + u_time), g = 0.5 + 0.5*sin(uv.y*10.0 + u_time*1.3), b = 0.5 + 0.5*sin((uv.x+uv.y)*10.0 + u_time*0.7). The vertex shader passes UV coordinates as a varying.
- Uniforms: u_time (float, seconds since start), u_resolution (vec2, canvas width/height), u_mouse (vec2, normalized mouse position 0-1).

## UI / DOM Elements
- A textarea element with id='shader-editor' positioned on the right side of the screen (width 35%, full height, monospace font, dark background #1e1e1e, white text, font-size 13px). Pre-filled with the default fragment shader source code.
- A button with id='btn-compile' labeled 'Compile Shader' above the editor.
- A button with id='btn-reset' labeled 'Reset Default' next to compile button.
- A dropdown select with id='preset-select' containing options: 'default', 'circles', 'noise', 'plasma', 'checkerboard'.
- A div with id='status-bar' below the editor showing compilation status: 'Ready' initially, 'Compiled OK' on success, or the GLSL error message on failure (red text for errors, green for success).
- A div with id='fps-display' in the top-left corner showing current FPS.
- A checkbox with id='chk-animate' labeled 'Animate' (checked by default). When unchecked, u_time stops incrementing.
- A range slider with id='slider-speed' (min=0.1, max=5.0, step=0.1, default=1.0) controlling animation speed multiplier.

## Preset Shaders
- 'circles': concentric circles from center using distance function, colored with time modulation.
- 'noise': simple pseudo-random noise pattern using fract(sin(dot(uv, vec2(12.9898,78.233)))*43758.5453).
- 'plasma': classic plasma effect using multiple overlapping sine waves.
- 'checkerboard': black and white checkerboard pattern (8x8 grid) with time-based color shifting.

## Interactions
- Clicking 'Compile Shader' reads the textarea content, attempts to compile it as a fragment shader. On success, swap the material. On failure, display the error in status-bar and keep the old shader.
- Clicking 'Reset Default' restores the default fragment shader in both the editor and the material.
- Changing the preset dropdown loads the corresponding shader source into the editor AND auto-compiles it.
- Mouse movement over the canvas updates u_mouse uniform.
- The animation checkbox toggles time progression.
- The speed slider multiplies the time delta.

## Compilation Tracking
- Track total successful compilations in a counter.
- Track total failed compilations in a separate counter.
- Track which preset is currently active (or 'custom' if user edited the code).

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame with:
- shaderCompiled: boolean (true if current shader compiled successfully)
- compilationCount: number (total successful compilations)
- failedCompilations: number (total failed compilations)
- currentPreset: string ('default'|'circles'|'noise'|'plasma'|'checkerboard'|'custom')
- animating: boolean (whether time is advancing)
- animationSpeed: number (current speed multiplier)
- elapsedTime: number (current u_time value)
- mouseX: number (normalized 0-1)
- mouseY: number (normalized 0-1)
- fps: number (current frames per second)
- statusText: string (current status bar text)
- editorContent: string (current textarea content)
- uniformsActive: boolean (true if u_time, u_resolution, u_mouse are all set on current material)
- lastCompileTimestamp: number (Date.now() of last successful compile)
- quadVisible: boolean (true if the shader quad mesh is visible and in scene)
- errorMessage: string (last error message, empty string if no error)
physics_constraints: u_time must increment monotonically when animating is true and must freeze when animating is false. Speed multiplier must clamp between 0.1 and 5.0. Mouse coordinates must be normalized to [0,1]. FPS must be a positive finite number. Compilation counters must be non-negative integers that only increment.
